name: mira-mini-test
construction: Questions were written against the extracted text of three papers whose PDFs state a CC BY 4.0 licence (see data/papers/MANIFEST.json). Page numbers are 1-based PDF pages. Each answerable item includes a short quotation that occurs on every cited page after whitespace is collapsed. Urdu questions and Urdu reference answers are translations of the paired English items and use the same gold pages; they were not collected as independent field questions. There was no second annotator and no inter-annotator agreement. Unanswerable questions ask about topics that do not occur in the three papers (BLEU, COVID-19 vaccines, LLaMA, photosynthesis). The disjoint pilot file is used only to set the evidence-gate threshold. Scores are reported on this test file only. This is a small project benchmark, not a community dataset.

items.answer_en: NN has nonnegative weights and nonnegative biases; PN has positive weights and nonnegative biases; NR has nonnegative weights and real-valued biases; RR has real-valued weights and real-valued biases.

items.question: Which journal published this work, who edited it, and what shape do the authors prove for the set of fixed points of nonnegative networks with nonnegative weights and biases?
items.answer: Journal of Machine Learning Research, volume 25 (2024), edited by Aryeh Kontorovich. The fixed point set is an interval, which under mild conditions degenerates to a point.
items.answer_en: Journal of Machine Learning Research, volume 25 (2024), edited by Aryeh Kontorovich. The fixed point set is an interval, which under mild conditions degenerates to a point.
